digest.component_or_area: snapshot entry store and reducer cache
propositions: Snapshot entries documented as immutable are mutated by every ticket read via .cache.json writes inside the entry directory
Reducer cache writes at reducer/_api.py:221 and reducer/_processors.py:58 occur inside snapshot entries when tracker root is pinned, violating content-addressed storage invariants
Reverify pass fails because TOFU digest taken before first read becomes invalid when subsequent reads add .cache.json files, causing false corruption detection
Hardlink blob-sharing optimization (b7a4994742) depends on atomic_write using os.replace; plain in-place writes would silently corrupt shared inodes
Reading a ticket through a pinned snapshot root must not write cache files into the snapshot entry
